## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The poem has extensive parallels across the wider *Dharmapada* and *Udānavarga* literature. SuttaCentral identifies passage-level parallels with verses 13 and 14 of the Pali *Dhammapada* (Dhp 13–14), the Gāndhārī *Dharmapada* (G-Dhp 201–223, Yamakavagga), the Patna *Dharmapada* (P-Dhp 342–357, Cittavagga), Chinese translations in T 210.9, T 212.32, and T 213.31, and Sanskrit as well as Tibetan recensions of the *Udānavarga* (UV 31, UVS 31, and Uv Kg 31, Cittavarga) [SuttaCentral].
In agreement with these parallels, automated analysis by DharmaNexus detects strong Pali-internal text reuse between segments §0.4–2.4 of the *Rādhattheragāthā* and the *Dhammapada* (§13.0–14.4), alongside parallel citations within the *Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā* (§403_6–409) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches exceeding the score threshold of 10 [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
